title: Lyft Ride Type
description: A Lyft ride type representing an available category of ride at a given location, including pricing details and passenger capacity.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the ride type.

seats.description: Maximum number of passenger seats available for this ride type.

image_url.description: URL to an image representing the ride type.

pricing_details.description: Pricing breakdown for this ride type.

PricingDetails.description: Pricing breakdown for a ride type. All monetary amounts are in the smallest denomination of the currency (e.g., cents for USD).

base_charge.description: Base fare amount in the smallest currency denomination.

cost_per_mile.description: Per-mile charge in the smallest currency denomination.

cost_per_minute.description: Per-minute charge in the smallest currency denomination.

cost_minimum.description: Minimum fare amount in the smallest currency denomination.

trust_and_service.description: Trust and service fee in the smallest currency denomination.

cancel_penalty_amount.description: Cancellation penalty amount in the smallest currency denomination.
